messages:
Eli H: hey team - starting in CS today, hi all :wave: quick ramp question: what exact accounts/tools do I need to be productive day 1? specifically: HubSpot, Aircall, call playbooks, and the objection-handling cheatsheet. who should I ping for each?
Katie O: welcome Eli!! :tada: CC @Mike (IT) for HubSpot/Aircall invites. For playbooks the canonical folder is in the playbooks drive (see Liz for tailored cs_funnel playbook).
Jamie R: @Eli H I run the playbook reviews — DM me and I’ll drop the 30-min sync deck. Also make sure you have access to the sales enablement Notion page (templates + scripts).
Mike (IT): Eli — I just kicked off the HubSpot invite (guest) and Aircall seat request. You should get two emails: one from hubspot-invite@redwood and one from aircall. If you don't see them, check spam then ping me.
Eli H: got it, thx. any special team defaults? call recording on/off? what about voicemail routing?
Liz C: Recording is enabled by default for training; if you need it off for any reason tag me and compliance. Voicemails route to the CS queue. There's a short doc: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/cs/call-routing (also pinned in #sales-resources).
Katie O: Also add the eclipse-runbook for handoffs (see playbooks -> handoffs). Pro tip: use the 'cs-templates' Aircall script for cross-sell intros.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Complete "Sales/CS Security & Tools" checklist within 48 hours: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs (progress saved).
Eli H: thanks! last one — objection handling cheat sheet name? couldn't find it in drive.
Jamie R: it's named "OBJECTION_MAP_v2 - CS" in the playbooks drive. I'll DM the link.
Mike (IT): Eli — confirm you received invites?
Eli H: received HubSpot invite, Aircall still pending. accepted HubSpot and set up MFA. thanks all :pray:
Katie O: sweet. ping @Jamie R and @Liz C for the 1:1 playbook walkthrough. welcome aboard again :rocket:
